title: Australia’s social media ban six months later – level 2
paragraphs: In December, Australia started a new law that stops children under 16 from using social media. The government wanted to protect the mental health of young people. But six months later, the law is not working well.

Studies show that most kids can still easily open and use accounts on Snapchat, Instagram, and YouTube. The tech companies don’t check the age of their users carefully. Children can lie about their age, or they can ask their parents to help them pass the face checks. The special computer programs which try to guess a user’s age don’t work well either.

Now, the government is very angry with the big tech companies. They doubled the fines for companies which don’t follow the rules. Other countries in the world are watching Australia to see if they should make similar laws.

using a camera or special computer software to look at a person’s face to check who they are or how old they look
